_readme: Images do one of two jobs (references/MEDIA-SOURCING.md §0):
comprehension — the script names something the viewer cannot see
Anything else is decoration. Where a card already carries the idea, no image.
Edit this file, run `node build-video.mjs`, Studio hot-reloads. Missing files
render as labelled placeholders so the edit can be timed before assets exist.
DELIBERATELY NOT PLACED — the cards already carry these:
card-09 lists all four models with their roles. That list IS the visual;
a logo beside it would split the beat.
GPT-OSS 120B @ 29.9   card-05 already carries it as a chip.
RTX 5090 / 4090 @ 101.5   card-16 already carries both as ghost chips.
Every benchmark number   the charts draw them.

logos.note: COMPREHENSION — he is holding the unit but it reads dark and angled on camera; the clean product shot is what the viewer can actually parse. Official transparent PNG, hyperframes capture of gigabyte.com (curl + WebFetch both 403).

ATTRIBUTION — sponsor pair on the thanks beat. gigabyte.svg is their own wordmark from the site capture. phongvu.png is still a placeholder: their homepage runs a promo modal over the header and the only wordmarks in the capture are ~130px wide, too small to use — drop the real file into media/logos/.
